Heard Mr. M. Rahman, learned counsel for the petitioners and Ms. S.H. Bora, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondent no. 1 State.

2. This criminal petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita [BNSS],
2023 is preferred seeking quashing and setting aside of the criminal proceeding arising out of P.R.
Case no. 626/2020, presently pending before the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Nagaon.
3. The marriage between the respondent no. 2 and the petitioner no. 1 was solemnized earlier.

Due to discords and differences, the respondent no. 2 lodged two First Information Reports [FIRs], one registered as Sootea Police Station Case no. 141/2018 under Sections 457/354/323/34, Indian Penal Code [IPC] and the other as Sootea Police Station Case no. 136/2018 under Sections 498A/34, IPC.
4.
A charge-sheet was laid in connection with Sootea Police Station Case no. 141/2018 and the case was registered as P.R. Case no. 135/2019 [corresponding G.R. Case no. 660/2018].

During the trial,
the respondent no. 2 deposing as P.W.1 stated that both the parties had reconciled the matter soon after filing of the FIRs.

Recording such testimony, the accused persons, that is, the petitioners herein were acquitted from the charges under Sections 448/354/323/34, IPC by the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, First Class, Biswanath in a Judgment dated 30.09.2023.
The petitioners and the respondent no. 2 have earlier entered into an agreement for settlement with regard to the subject-matters of the FIRs.

It is in such backdrop, the prayer for quashing and setting aside of the proceeding of P.R. Case no. 626/2020 has been made.
Page No.# 3/3 5. Issue notice, returnable on 09.03.2026.
6.
As Ms. Bora, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared and accepted notice on behalf of the respondent no. 1, issuance of formal notice to the respondent no. 1 is dispensed with.
The learned counsel for the petitioners shall furnish an extra copy of the criminal petition along with the annexures to Ms. Bora within 3 [three] working days from today.

Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 30 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83486237/
2 7.
The petitioners shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no. 2 by speed post within 3 [three] working days from today.

8. Having regard to the projections made in the afore-stated manner, it is ordered, in the interim,
that the further proceeding of P.R. Case no. 626/2020, presently pending before the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nagaon shall remain suspended till the returnable date.
